title: The Hottest Liquid on Earth (Heavy-ion collisions and the quark-gluon plasma)
summary: Colliding heavy nuclei make a droplet of quark-gluon plasma, a nearly perfect liquid at a few trillion degrees. How we know it is a liquid, and what is still not understood.
